name:        DropdownMenuDivider
domain:      component
package:     @astryxdesign/core
import:      @astryxdesign/core/DropdownMenu
description: A horizontal rule separating groups of rows in a compound menu. Renders role="separator", so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the separator; its role and orientation stay component-owned.
